points: Play the story as Jason and Lucia through all five chapters. No gold medals are needed in story missions.
Right after the mission Down to Earth in Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — the one possibly missable step in the whole game.
Take optional missions as they appear, especially the ones that introduce robberies, fishing and hunting.
Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study new animals with binoculars as you travel — you will need 200 vehicles and 100 animals later.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter. There is no mission replay and 15 save slots.
Leave cheats off: they disable trophies and saving while active.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Play the story, collect as you go

points: After the final mission, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work down the checklist below.
Clear every robbery first: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults (unlocked by That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4).
Then the fixed counts: 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 42 Drone Time Trials, 15 Bret Target Decks, 33 underwater discoveries.
Fill the partial categories only to their checklist number — stop at 15 card sets, 100 flamingos, 200 vehicles, 100 animals, 70 challenges. Do not hunt for everything.
Win 30 of the 40 races and reach 300 stunts on the way — both are higher than their own trophies ask.
stages.title: Stage 2 — 100% completion in free roam

points: Finish the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, and complete 8 Strangers & Freaks strands in total.
Meditate at every remaining spot for Positive Mental Attitude (18 in all).
Pick up the miscellaneous trophies: partner robberies, the Rhino tank, the VCIA jet, the jewelry store, the showroom and the bowling alley.
Check the trophy list against this guide — the platinum pops when the last one lands.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Strangers, cleanup, platinum

tips: Do the Chapter 1 meditation. It is the only step in the game that may not come back.
Scan vehicles early. 200 base-model scans after the story is a long, dull drive; 100 of them happen naturally if you scan as you go.
Study animals during exploration. You need 100 species, not 255 — binoculars out whenever you cross new terrain.
Do not collect everything. The 100% checklist only wants portions of most categories; check the numbers before grinding.
Finish robberies thoroughly. Grab every key valuable in Gang Operations and robberies so you never have to return.
Save the challenges for last. Many complete naturally, and you can skip the 10 hardest — 100% needs only 70 of 80.
Keep multiple manual saves. No mission replay means a chapter save is your only way back.
